name: qark_apply
title: Write or edit files atomically
description: Create, replace, edit, move, or delete one or many files under the workspace root in one atomic change set. Every file is rendered, contract-checked, and syntax-checked (Python, Node, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, TOML, plus staged project checks) before anything is written; a conflict, contract violation, or failed check writes nothing. Accepts either a multi-file files:[...] array OR top-level single-file shorthand (path + text|lines|tmpl|template|json|edits|move|delete, or flat edit fields). Relative paths and full paths inside the workspace root both work. Returns a receipt with each file's sha256, status, and AST semantic change preview (added/modified/removed symbols).

path.description: Single-file shorthand path (relative to workspace root, or full path inside root). May use {{vars}}.

glob.description: Single-glob shorthand: apply edits across every workspace file matching this glob (e.g. src/**/*.py) in one atomic commit.

text.description: Single-file shorthand: the file's full text as written.

lines.description: Single-file shorthand: array of strings joined with \n, OR [first, last] 1-based line range when used with 'with'.

tmpl.description: Single-file shorthand: inline Handlebars-style template ({{name}}, {{#each xs}}, {{#if x}}, {{x|py}}).

template.description: Single-file shorthand: name of a template from templates, qark_templates, or builtins.

json.description: Single-file shorthand: any JSON value, written as pretty JSON.

edits.description: Single-file shorthand: array of edit objects (or one edit object) applied in order.

move.description: Single-file shorthand: source path moved to path atomically.

delete.description: Single-file shorthand: true removes the file.

files.description: Multi-file change set. Each entry has path (or glob) and one content source (text, lines, tmpl, template, json, edits, move, delete, or flat edit keys).

path.description: Relative to workspace root (or full path inside root). May use {{vars}}.

glob.description: Apply edits across every workspace file matching this glob (e.g. src/**/*.py) in one atomic commit.

lines.description: Lines joined with \n, or [first, last] line range when paired with 'with'.

tmpl.description: Inline Handlebars-style template: {{name}}, {{#each xs}}, {{#if x}}, {{x|py}} literal filters.

template.description: Name of a template from templates, qark_templates, or builtins.

json.description: Any JSON value, written as pretty JSON.

edits.description: Edits to the current file, in order: {symbol, with|body|signature|rename}; {find, replace|with, all?, count?, occurrence?, within?, symbol?}; {find_re, replace|with, ...}; {lines:[first,last], with}; {insert_before|insert_after, with, auto_indent?}; {append}; {prepend}; {ex}; {keys}.

symbol.description: Flat edit shorthand: AST symbol name (e.g. 'process' or 'Worker.run') to edit with body, signature, rename, or with.

body.description: Flat edit shorthand: replace only the symbol's body (string or string[]) while preserving its signature and braces/indentation.

signature.description: Flat edit shorthand: replace only the symbol's declaration signature.

rename.description: Flat edit shorthand: rename the symbol declaration and identifier references in scope.

find.description: Flat edit shorthand: exact text to find and replace.

find_re.description: Flat edit shorthand: regex to find and replace (supports \0-\9 captures).

replace.description: Flat edit shorthand: replacement text for find or find_re.

insert_before.description: Flat edit shorthand: 1-based line, anchor string, or {symbol|find|find_re} to insert before.

insert_after.description: Flat edit shorthand: 1-based line, anchor string, or {symbol|find|find_re} to insert after.

auto_indent.description: Flat edit shorthand: match indentation of anchor line on insert.

contract.description: Enforced scope contract: {symbol?, symbols?, methods?, lines?: [first, last], preserve_signatures?, max_lines_changed?, forbid_delete?}.

rebase.description: When expect is stale, perform a 3-way line merge against the historical base in .qark/undo (or base_text).

base_text.description: Explicit base text for 3-way proposal rebasing.

move.description: Source path moved to this path atomically.

with.description: Template variables object for tmpl/template, OR replacement string/lines for flat edits.

each.description: A list (or name of a list in vars) to fan this entry out over.

expect.description: sha256 the current file must have.

check.description: false to skip syntax check, or checker name: python, node, powershell, bash, json, toml.

templates.description: Inline templates by name: a string, or {text|lines, lang}.

job.description: Write under jobs/<job>/ and add manifest.json with every file's sha256.

run.description: With job: how the executor should run it, recorded in manifest.json.

prune.description: With job: delete files from previous manifest no longer produced.

dry_run.description: Render, check, and compute semantic diff, report what would happen, write nothing.

preview.description: Include each file's rendered text in the receipt.

diff.description: Include a unified diff of each changed file in the receipt.

check.description: true/"strict" (default: fail closed on syntax error or checker crash), "required" (also reject skipped/missing runtimes), "permissive" (allow checker crashes as skipped with validation_complete: false), or false/"off".

contract.description: Enforced scope contract across all files: {symbol?, symbols?, methods?, lines?, preserve_signatures?, max_lines_changed?, forbid_delete?}.

rebase.description: Enable 3-way proposal rebasing when expect hashes are stale against non-overlapping concurrent edits.

validate.description: Project validation command (array of argv strings or {cmd: [...]}) staged and executed before commit; non-zero exit rolls back.

stream.description: Include per-phase transaction timing and status events in receipt.events.

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_edit
title: Surgical AST symbol or text edit
description: Edit an existing file (or glob of files) atomically using flat top-level parameters—no nested files/edits wrapper required. Supports AST-aware symbol edits (pass symbol + body, signature, rename, or with), exact find/replace, regex find_re/replace (with \0-\9 captures), line-range replacement (lines:[first,last] + with), and anchored insertions (insert_before/insert_after + with, auto_indent). Enforces optional scope contracts, 3-way rebasing on stale expect hashes, syntax checking, and returns a receipt with sha256 and semantic symbol diff.

path.description: File path to edit (relative to workspace root, or full path inside root).

glob.description: Apply this edit across all matching workspace files (e.g. src/**/*.py) in one atomic commit.

symbol.description: AST symbol name (e.g. 'compute' or 'Service.run'). Combine with body, signature, rename, or with—or combine with find/find_re to scope the search to this symbol.

body.description: Replace only the named symbol's body (string or array of line strings), automatically preserving its declaration signature, indentation, and closing brace.

signature.description: Replace only the named symbol's declaration/signature line(s) while keeping its body intact.

rename.description: Rename the symbol declaration and all word-bounded identifier occurrences in scope.

with.description: Replacement text (string or array of line strings) when replacing a full symbol, a [first,last] line range, or inserting with insert_before/insert_after.

find.description: Exact text to find in the file (or within the scoped symbol/range).

find_re.description: Qark regex (. [] () | * + ? {} ^ $ \< \> \d \w \s) to find; replacement may use \0-\9 captures.

replace.description: Replacement text for find or find_re.

lines.description: [first, last] 1-based inclusive line range to replace with 'with'.

insert_before.description: 1-based line number, anchor string, or {symbol|find|find_re, occurrence?} to insert 'with' before.

insert_after.description: 1-based line number, anchor string, or {symbol|find|find_re, occurrence?} to insert 'with' after.

auto_indent.description: When inserting with insert_before/insert_after, automatically indent inserted lines to match the anchor line.

append.description: Text to append to the end of the file.

prepend.description: Text to prepend to the start of the file.

within.description: Scope find/find_re/insert to [first, last] lines, an exact substring, or {symbol|find|find_re, occurrence?}.

all.description: Replace all occurrences of find or find_re.

occurrence.description: Pick a specific match of find or find_re (1-based, or -1 for last).

count.description: Require exactly this many matches of find or find_re.

edits.description: Optional list of multiple edit objects to apply sequentially to path or glob.

contract.description: Enforced scope contract: {symbol?: string, symbols?: string[], methods?: string[], lines?: [first, last], preserve_signatures?: boolean, max_lines_changed?: integer, forbid_delete?: boolean}.

expect.description: Expected sha256 of the file before editing.

rebase.description: If true and expect is stale, 3-way merge the edit onto the current file using .qark/undo history or base_text.

base_text.description: Optional explicit base text when rebase is true.

validate.description: Project validation command (array of argv strings or {cmd: [...]}) to run before committing.

diff.description: Include unified diff in the receipt.

dry_run.description: Preview the edit, syntax check, and semantic diff without writing to disk.

check.description: true/"strict" (default: fail closed on syntax error or checker crash), "required", "permissive", false, or a checker name.

tag.description: Optional tag recorded in the undo snapshot and journal.

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_read
title: Read files, symbols, outlines, or folded views
description: Read files under the workspace root with their sha256, byte count, and line count. A directory path lists its entries ("." is the root). Pass symbol or symbols to read only specific functions/classes/methods by AST span, outline: true to list all symbols in a file without reading its body, or fold: true to get a compact signature-folded view of the file (with optional symbols expanded).

path.description: File or directory path (relative to workspace root, or full path inside root).

paths.description: Multiple file or directory paths to read in one call.

symbol.description: Read only the named symbol (function, class, record, section, or Class.method) with first_line and last_line.

symbols.description: Read multiple named symbols in one call (returns spans[]), or keep these symbols expanded when fold is true.

fold.description: Return a compact signature-folded view of the file (keeping imports, types, and declarations while collapsing function bodies to ...).

outline.description: Include the file's symbol outline: name, kind, line, and end_line for functions, classes, records, and sections.

content.description: false returns only sha256, bytes, lines, and optional outline without file text.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of text to return per file (default 262144).

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_search
title: Search workspace or list files
description: Search the workspace like ripgrep: pattern is literal text, or set regex: true for the Qark regex dialect (. [] () | * + ? {} ^ $ \< \> \d \w \s). Matches are grouped per file with that file's sha256, line/col, matched text, and enclosing AST symbol name. Omit pattern to list matching file paths. Skips .git, .qark, node_modules, and build directories unless all: true.

pattern.description: Literal text or regex pattern to search for. Omit to list workspace files.

regex.description: Treat pattern as a Qark regex (. [] () | * + ? {} ^ $ \< \> \d \w \s).

glob.description: Filter files by glob, e.g. *.py, src/**/*.mach, scripts/*.ps1.

path.description: Directory to search, relative to workspace root (or full path inside root).

context.description: Lines of context around each match, 0-20.

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_impact
title: Symbol reference & impact graph
description: Trace a symbol across the workspace to build its resolved reference and impact graph before refactoring or changing a signature. Returns definitions (file, kind, line, end_line), references (file, line, col, text, and enclosing symbol), imports, dependents, affected_files, and affected_symbols.

symbol.description: The identifier or symbol name to trace across the workspace.

glob.description: Optional file glob filter, e.g. **/*.py or src/**/*.mach.

path.description: Optional subdirectory to restrict the impact analysis to.

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_undo
title: Persistent multi-file undo & redo
description: Atomically revert one or more applied transactions using persistent snapshots in .qark/undo, redo a previously undone transaction (redo: true), or list the undo history stack (list: true). Verifies each file's sha256 before reverting unless force: true is set.

steps.description: Number of transactions to walk back and revert (default 1).

redo.description: true to redo the most recently undone transaction.

list.description: true to list the undo transaction chain and any available redo_txn without changing files.

txn.description: Specific transaction id to undo or redo (default 'latest').

force.description: Overwrite files even if they were modified after the transaction.

dry_run.description: Preview what would be reverted or redone without writing to disk.

diff.description: Include unified diffs of reverted/redone files in the receipt.

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_check
title: Validate project, verify job, or inspect capabilities
description: Run standalone project-wide validation (using validate/cmd or .qark/checks.json), verify a job directory against its manifest.json (dir), read the transaction event journal (events: true), or query Qark's capabilities (capabilities: true) and operation schemas (schema: true).

validate.description: Project validation command (array of argv strings such as ["pytest", "-q"] or {cmd: [...], timeout_ms?: 30000}). If omitted, uses project in .qark/checks.json.

cmd.description: Alias for validate: command argv array to run in the workspace root.

dir.description: Verify a job directory (e.g. jobs/etl) against its manifest.json hashes.

capabilities.description: true to return Qark's version, features, symbol_edit_modes, contract_fields, languages, limits, and active checkers.

schema.description: true (or an operation name string) to return machine-readable input/output schemas.

events.description: true to read transaction events from .qark/journal.ndjson.

since_offset.description: With events: byte offset in .qark/journal.ndjson to read from.

limit.description: With events: max events to return (default 100).

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_templates
title: List or inspect templates
description: List the templates qark_apply can name (session, workspace .qark/templates, and builtin), each with its language, description, and the variables it reads. Pass name to get one template's full text.

name.description: Optional template name to inspect its full source text.

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.

name: qark_define_template
title: Define a reusable template
description: Keep a named template for later qark_apply calls in this session, so many files can share it. Set persist: true to save it under .qark/templates for future sessions.

lang.description: Language for literal/ident filters (py, js, json, ps, sh).

path.description: Default output path pattern for expand tables, e.g. gen/{{name|snake}}.py.

root.description: Optional workspace root directory path to target.
